metadata.coverage_note: Selected local Visayan 1997 baseline; all 250 catch labels reviewed and conditional GE/TE/With Egestion arithmetic available. Approximate marine overlap: A 1–2% of the full Sulu-Celebes target, B 90–100% of the study (trace A 1.59156%, B 98.04861%; not author GIS). The model explicitly includes commercial waters plus both inside-domain and outside-domain municipal waters of all 33 municipalities/cities (2023 §2.1, PDF 2), with a reported area of 16,728.5 km². The 2026 §2.2 baseline reuse supports that extent; its dashed figure is indicative. The 2023 Figure 1 envelope is registered to the 2026 graticule; reconstructed marine area is 16,457.4 km². Accepted 1997 parameters match 2026 Table 1; diet/catch lineage matches the 2023 supplement. The later 2004/2009/2014 surveys in Table S3 support membership, not observed 1997 stage caught-mass shares. All direct methods remain WARN, strict input/budget balance false, and TE Seabirds near singular. Canonical and runtime assumptions remain accepted. Numerical availability does not establish whole-LME applicability or production admission. The 2018 endpoint remains unselected and NOT_RUN. Evidence: regions/LME_037/validation_reports/Bacalso2026_Visayan_Sea_1997_baseline/source_review.md
